title: Ground-Up Dissection of QCA988x Xtensa wal_peer 32-Parameter Table and Per-Peer Rate/Retry Context Offsets

wal_peer_struct_layout.evidence: Dereferenced in Slot 0 (`l32i.n a10, a5, 0` -> `l32i.n a9, a10, 12`) to notify `wal_vdev` on peer unpause.
Dereferenced in Slot 25 (`l32i.n a2, a5, 8`) to walk linked list of per-peer TIDs (`0x0098fb7c`).
Bit 0 (`0x1`): AUTHORIZED (Slot 27); Bit 1 (`0x2`): QOS_CAPABLE (Slot 23); Bit 2 (`0x4`): HT_CAPABLE (Slot 24); Bits 11..31 (`0xfffff800`): MFP/PMF (Slot 26).
Byte 0 (`+36`): TID sleep state (Slot 18 get); Bits 8..9: PS state machine (Slot 8); Bit 21 (`0x00200000`): NON_AGG_RTS_ENABLE (Slot 28).
Checked in Slot 18 (`l16ui a11, a5, 40`) before invoking `0x00997c14` / `0x00997a9c`.

Bits 0..7 (`+48`): KEY_TYPE (Slot 2); Bits 24..25: USE_4ADDR_MODE (Slot 7); Bit 26: PS active (Slot 8); Bit 27: DEFAULT_KEY_FLAG (Slot 3); Bit 28: UAPSD_TRIGGER (Slot 12); Bit 29: UAPSD_DELIVERY (Slot 13); Bit 30 (`0x40000000`): PAUSE_STATE (Slot 0).
Read/written in Slot 1 (`s8i a4, a5, 49` / `l8ui a2, a2, 49`).
Read/written in Slot 10 (`s8i a4, a5, 50` / `l8ui a2, a2, 50`).
Read/written in Slot 4 (`s16i a4, a5, 52` / `l16ui a2, a2, 52`).
Read/written in Slot 6 (`s16i a4, a5, 54` / `l16ui a2, a2, 54`); Bit 14 (`0x4000`) controlled by Slot 25.
Read/written in Slot 11 (`s16i a4, a5, 58` / `l16ui a2, a2, 58`).
Read/written in Slot 17 (`s32i a4, a5, 64` / `l32i a2, a2, 64`): primary per-peer rate-control (`peer_rc_ctxt`) pointer.
Read/written in Slot 15 (`s32i a4, a5, 68` / `l32i a2, a2, 68`): secondary per-peer rate/scheduler context pointer.
Read/written in Slot 16 (`s32i a4, a5, 72` / `l32i a2, a2, 72`): tertiary per-peer airMAX/TDMA extension pointer.

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_PAUSE_STATE
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: Controls per-peer TX pause state (`peer+0x30` bit 30 `0x40000000`). If `val==1` and not already paused, sets bit 30 and invokes `wal_peer_pause` (`0x0098cee0`). If `val==0` and paused, clears bit 30 (`mask 0xbfffffff`), invokes `wal_peer_unpause` (`0x0098ccf8`), and if `*(peer+0x30) & 0x3f000000 == 0` notifies `vdev` ops (`*(*(peer+0x00)+0xc)`). `get_param` returns `3` (unsupported read).

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_MCAST_BCAST_ECHO
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: Reads/writes `uint8_t` at `peer + 0x31` (`s8i a4, a5, 49` / `l8ui a2, a2, 49`). Controls multicast/broadcast echo suppression per peer.

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_KEY_TYPE
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: Reads/writes low byte (`uint8_t`) at `peer + 0x30` (`s8i a4, a5, 48` / `l8ui a2, a2, 48`), storing per-peer cipher/key type.

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_DEFAULT_KEY_FLAG
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: Reads/writes bit 27 (`0x08000000`, clear mask `0xf7ffffff`) of `*(uint32_t*)(peer + 0x30)` (`extui a2, a2, 27, 1`).

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_ASSOC_OR_PS_TIM_ID
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: Reads/writes `uint16_t` at `peer + 0x34` (`s16i a4, a5, 52` / `l16ui a2, a2, 52`).

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_RESERVED_05
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: No-op slot in both `set_param` (`0x0098c161`) and `get_param` (`0x0098c54f`, returns `0`).

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_MAX_SP_OR_FLAGS16
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: Reads/writes `uint16_t` at `peer + 0x36` (`s16i a4, a5, 54` / `l16ui a2, a2, 54`). Note that bit 14 (`0x4000`) of `peer+0x36` is also manipulated by Slot 25.

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_USE_4ADDR_MODE
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: Reads/writes 2-bit field at bits 24..25 (`mask 0xfcffffff`) of `*(uint32_t*)(peer + 0x30)` (`extui a2, a2, 24, 2`). Controls 4-address WDS framing mode.

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_POWERSAVE_STATE_MACHINE
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: Updates 2-bit PS state at `peer+0x24` bits 8..9 (`mask 0xfffffcff`), updates `peer+0x30` bit 26 (`0x04000000`, `mask 0xfbffffff`), invokes `wal_peer_ps_change` (`0x0098caf0`), and dispatches callback table at `*(0x0040d058) + 8`.

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_RESERVED_09
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: No-op slot in both `set_param` (`0x0098c161`) and `get_param` (`0x0098c54f`, returns `0`).

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_AMPDU_FACTOR
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: Reads/writes `uint8_t` at `peer + 0x32` (`s8i a4, a5, 50` / `l8ui a2, a2, 50`), controlling maximum A-MPDU length exponent (`2^(13+factor)-1`).

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_AMPDU_DENSITY
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: Reads/writes `uint16_t` at `peer + 0x3a` (`s16i a4, a5, 58` / `l16ui a2, a2, 58`), controlling MPDU minimum start spacing / density.

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_UAPSD_TRIGGER_CAP
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: Reads/writes bit 28 (`0x10000000`, clear mask `0xefffffff`) of `*(uint32_t*)(peer + 0x30)` (`extui a2, a2, 28, 1`).

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_UAPSD_DELIVERY_CAP
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: Reads/writes bit 29 (`0x20000000`, clear mask `0xdfffffff`) of `*(uint32_t*)(peer + 0x30)` (`extui a7, a2, 29, 1`).

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_RESERVED_14
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: No-op slot (`set_param` -> `0x0098c161`, `get_param` -> `0x0098c55a` writing `0` to `*out_ptr`).

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_RC_SCHED_CTX_44
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: Reads/writes `uint32_t` at `peer + 0x44` (`s32i a4, a5, 68` / `l32i a2, a2, 68`). Stores per-peer rate-control / TX scheduler context pointer #2.

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_RC_SCHED_CTX_48
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: Reads/writes `uint32_t` at `peer + 0x48` (`s32i a4, a5, 72` / `l32i a2, a2, 72`). Stores per-peer rate-control / airMAX TDMA peer extension pointer #3.

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_RC_SCHED_CTX_40
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: Reads/writes `uint32_t` at `peer + 0x40` (`s32i a4, a5, 64` / `l32i a2, a2, 64`). Stores primary per-peer rate-control (`g_pRATE` / `peer_rc_ctxt`) pointer #1.

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_TID_PAUSE_OR_UAPSD_SP
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: `set_param` checks `*(uint16_t*)(peer + 0x28)` (`l16ui a11, a5, 40`): if non-zero, calls `0x00997c14` (`val != 0`) or `0x00997a9c` (`val == 0`). `get_param` reads `uint8_t` at `peer + 0x24` (`l8ui a2, a2, 36`).

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_RESERVED_19
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: No-op slot (`0x0098c161` / `0x0098c59b` writing `0` to `*out_ptr`).

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_RESERVED_20
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: No-op slot (`0x0098c161` / `0x0098c59b` writing `0` to `*out_ptr`).

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_RESERVED_21
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: No-op slot (`0x0098c161` / `0x0098c59b` writing `0` to `*out_ptr`).

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_RESERVED_22
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: No-op slot (`0x0098c161` / `0x0098c59b` writing `0` to `*out_ptr`).

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_QOS_CAPABLE
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: Sets/clears bit 1 (`0x2`, clear mask `0xfffffffd`) of `*(uint32_t*)(peer + 0x20)` (`peer_flags`). Indicates WMM/QoS capability.

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_HT_CAPABLE
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: Sets/clears bit 2 (`0x4`, clear mask `0xfffffffb`) of `*(uint32_t*)(peer + 0x20)` (`peer_flags`). Indicates 802.11n HT capability.

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_VHT_OR_TID_AGG_ENABLE
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: Sets/clears bit 14 (`0x4000`, clear mask `0xffffbfff`) of `*(uint16_t*)(peer + 0x36)`. When `val == 0`, walks the linked list of per-peer TIDs starting at `*(peer + 0x08)` (`next` at `+0x00`) and invokes `0x0098fb7c` on each TID.

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_PMF_MFP_CAPABLE
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: Sets/clears mask `0xfffff800` (clear mask `0x000007ff`) of `*(uint32_t*)(peer + 0x20)` (`peer_flags`).

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_AUTHORIZED
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: Sets/clears bit 0 (`0x1`, clear mask `0xfffffffe`) of `*(uint32_t*)(peer + 0x20)` (`peer_flags`). Controls 802.1X/WPA peer port authorization.

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_NON_AGG_RTS_ENABLE
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: Sets/clears bit 21 (`0x00200000`, clear mask `0xffdfffff`) of `*(uint32_t*)(peer + 0x24)` (`extui a2, a2, 21, 1`). Enables RTS/CTS protection on non-aggregated MPDUs.

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_RESERVED_29
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: No-op slot (`0x0098c161` / `0x0098c59b` writing `0` to `*out_ptr`).

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_RESERVED_30
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: No-op slot (`0x0098c161` / `0x0098c59b` writing `0` to `*out_ptr`).

wal_peer_param_table.semantics: No-op slot (`0x0098c161` / `0x0098c59b` writing `0` to `*out_ptr`).

wal_peer_param_table.name: WAL_PEER_PARAM_RESERVED_32
wal_peer_param_table.semantics: No-op slot (`0x0098c161` / `0x0098c59b` writing `0` to `*out_ptr`).

pillar_a_ground_up_re_and_knob_catalog.evidence: Instruction-level Xtensa disassembly of all 33 slots (0..32) of wal_peer_set_param (0x0098c0c0) and wal_peer_get_param (0x0098c4c8), recovering exact struct offsets 0x00..0x48.

pillar_b_hyperresearch_and_scholar_react.evidence: Cross-checked WAL peer parameter semantics against QCA 10.1/10.2 WAL header definitions and Stage 471A/473A Xtensa rate-control findings.

pillar_c_karpathy_autoresearch_and_watch.evidence: Purely offline static analysis (`live_devices_touched=False`); discovers how WMI_PEER_SET_PARAM_CMDID and HT_COMM bridge into `wal_peer` offsets `0x20..0x48`.

pillar_d_scientific_pareto_validation.evidence: Verified 100% byte-identity (`sha256` match) of `wal_peer_set_param` and `wal_peer_get_param` across `WA.v8.7.25` and `XC.v8.7.25` PtP `SGMT` binaries.
